mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months reduces discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress corporate profit growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeded 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer spending that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased consecutively, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month decline in industrial production signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declined for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts over three months reflects expanding residential construction activity that supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST increased for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI exceeding 3.5% indicates persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeded 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in non-farm payrolls and decreases in unemployment rate indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased consecutively, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month increase in the federal funds rate signals active monetary tightening that raises borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
